"''Which makes it the perfect place to hide out.|Hunter and Wrecker|}} '''Idaflor''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Idaflor system]] within the [[Sarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] and [[Trailing Sectors]]. It was situated in grid square O-18 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] and was connected by a [[Farstine–Svivren hyperlane|hyperspace route]] to the celestial bodies [[Yar Togna]] and the [[Vohai system]].[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] places the [[Vohai system]] on a [[hyperspace route]] between what [[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] identifies as the locations of Idaflor and [[Chagar IX]] on that same route. By [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Cornered]]" to [[19 BBY]]. Idaflor was uninhabited. That [[Standard year|year]], as the [[Cloning|clones]] of [[Clone Force 99]] discussed what they should do after [[Escape from Kamino|deserting]] from the [[Galactic Empire]], an image of Idaflor was displayed on a [[computer]] screen in their [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|starship]], and the group's leader,''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Hunter]], stated they would head there. After the clone [[Wrecker]] countered that Idaflor was not inhabited, Hunter noted that fact made it an ideal location for them. However, they were unable to travel to Idaflor, as they did not have enough [[fuel]] and also needed supplies, forcing the group to instead head for the Outer Rim [[moon]] [[Pantora]]. After leaving Pantora, they ultimately traveled to{{TBB|Rampage (episode)}} the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]]. ==Behind the scenes== Idaflor first appeared on a screen in "[[Cornered]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' which aired on [[May 21]], [[2021]].{{InsiderCite|206|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season One Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season One Companion}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Cornered}} {{1st}} {{C|Appears on screen}} ==Sources== *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Idaflor}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Idaflor |ja=アイダフロア |ka=აიდაფლორი |nl=Idaflor |pl=Idaflor }} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Trailing Sectors]] [[Category:Locations along the Farstine–Svivren hyperlane]] [[Category:Sarin sector locations]]
